aliases: Surrey Pre-trial Services Centre – Expansion Project
companyFieldUpdates.description: Surrey Pretrial Services Centre Expansion Project is an availability-based correctional-facility PPP in Surrey, British Columbia, delivered through Brookfield Infrastructure Partnerships Surrey. The DBFM concession covers a 216-cell expansion, renovations to the existing facility and long-term facilities maintenance for the provincial corrections system, with concession expiry on October 31, 2043. Brookfield and Forum were the original 2011 sponsors; Forum consolidated Brookfield's interests in 2015; and Fiera Infrastructure acquired 100% on April 19, 2016. Fiera continues to list Surrey as an unrealized Woodford Social Infrastructure investment under EagleCrest Infrastructure Canada LP. Surrey was not in JLIF's complete pre-takeover portfolio, so Equitix, Dalmore and Jura did not acquire it in 2018. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
